authoredNote: Every line below was TRANSCRIBED from a measured run (script/m14/tmp/dt-fixture-dump.ts) and checked against the source with the claimed line's text printed under each edge: 26 is `extension type Wrapper._(Shape shape$) implements Shape {` (container, representation field and heritage all name on it), 27 is the overriding `area`, 29 `static bool isA(...)`, 32 the `Plain` header, 33 the `doubled` getter. The forbid entries are the two pre-fix shapes the probe MEASURED before the fix: top-level symbols with no owner, and the representation field's own declaration published as a read.
rationale: M60 DARTD21 — the Dart 3 container the lane never saw, found twice independently. (1) It is registered as MISSING in the lane's own completeness spec (script/m14/spec/dart-completeness.json: "Dart 3 extension type symbols", node_type "extension_type_declaration, representation_declaration"), and the M60 shape census records the node types as UNSCANNED (validation/m60/results/unscanned-shapes.json, 169 occurrences each). (2) The #753 duplicate census over the FULL extent (2,547 files) surfaced it from the opposite direction: 132 of its 137 duplicate-name rows were extension-type MEMBERS in dart-http's generated jni/objc bindings (303 declarations in 4 pinned files) — the analyzer had no case for the container, so every member was emitted as a TOP-LEVEL symbol with owner=undefined, no `contains`, no heritage, and no enclosing type for a call (probe: dt-exttype-shape.ts, which prints the CST and the analyzer's answer side by side). The fix adds the container: a symbol (kind extension, metadata isExtensionType + the alias-free representation type), the representation field as a real property member (Dart exposes `field` on the type), the container scope so members carry ownerName/scope, and the `implements` clause through the same heritage extractor a class uses. It also had to REMOVE a fabrication its own first measurement exposed: with the container known, the representation field's declaration name was being read as a value (`uses Wrapper -> shape$` on line 26), so `representation_declaration` joined the declaration-name parent set on BOTH sides (analyzer isDartDeclNameParent and the oracle's DECL_PARENTS) — the family rule that an analyzer fix and its truth instrument move together. Reverting mutant: dart/extension-type-members-unowned.

correction_2026_10_08: Two rounds touched this file. (1) The two bare representation-field READS moved to `Wrapper.shape$` / `Wrapped.inner$`. (2) The `contains` round qualified every member target to its published `Owner.member` spelling, so the seven contains rows and the two forbid rows below moved with it. The forbids keep their teeth: `forbidRelationships` matches by EXACT target equality (script/m14/run-fixtures.ts:matchConstraints), so the fabrication of (1) returns as `uses Wrapper -> Wrapper.shape$` and the phantom of (2) as `contains Wrapped -> Wrapped.inner$ @44` — leaving either forbid on the old bare spelling would have made it unfireable. The forbidden LINES (26, 44) are unchanged.
